```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(xgboost)
  library(PRROC)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")

DATA_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
XGB_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output/xgBoost_outputs")

MODEL_DIR  <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models", "consensus_models")
PRED_DIR   <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions", "xgb_consensus_all_features")

dir.create(MODEL_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(PRED_DIR,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

data_file      <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data_noSNP.tsv")
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files",
                            "training_data_snppg_aggregated_new.tsv.gz")
predictor_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictors.txt")

```

```{r}
full_data     <- fread(data_file)
training_data <- fread(training_file)

# --- map cell types ---

ct_map <- c(
Ast = "astrocytes",
MG  = "Microglia",
OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
OPC = "OPC",
IN  = "Neurons",
Ext = "Neurons",
End = "Endothelial"
)

remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)

training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

# --- merge by full identity ---

training_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]

index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "chr")

setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)

data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# --- labels ---

data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

```

```{r}
# --- features ---
predictors <- scan(predictor_file, what = character(), quiet = TRUE)
feature_cols <- intersect(predictors, names(data))

exclude_features <- c("predEnhancer_g_exp_score", "predEnhancer_g_lin_beta", "predEnhancer_g_lin_score", "predEnhancer_p_exp_beta", "predEnhancer_p_exp_score", "predEnhancer_p_lin_beta", "predEnhancer_p_lin_score", "predEnhancer_g_exp_beta")
feature_cols <- setdiff(feature_cols, exclude_features)

#exclude_features <- c("tad_n_boundaries", "tad_pyt_score", "tad_sum_score")
exclude_features <- c("gene_logCPM", "conservation")
feature_cols <- setdiff(feature_cols, exclude_features)

feature_cols <- c("peak_gene_distance", "closest_tss","scent", "signac", "cicero" )

message("Merged data with ", nrow(data), " rows and ", length(feature_cols), " features.")
```


```{r}
tuning_dir <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output/xgBoost_outputs/tuning/xgBoost_tuning_500evals_allParams")

files <- list.files(tuning_dir, pattern = "^tuning_instance_.*\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

archives <- lapply(files, function(f) {
inst <- readRDS(f)
best <- as.data.table(inst$archive$best())
best[, celltype := sub("tuning_instance_(.*)\\.rds", "\\1", basename(f))]
return(best)
})

all_params <- rbindlist(archives, fill = TRUE)

avg_params <- all_params[, lapply(.SD, mean),
.SDcols = setdiff(names(all_params), "celltype")]

consensus_params <- list(
booster          = "gbtree",
objective        = "binary",
eval_metric      = "aucpr",
eta              = avg_params$eta,
max_depth        = round(avg_params$max_depth),
lambda           = avg_params$lambda,
alpha            = avg_params$alpha,
min_child_weight = avg_params$min_child_weight,
subsample        = avg_params$subsample,
colsample_bytree = avg_params$colsample_bytree,
gamma            = avg_params$gamma
)

```
```{r}
consensus_params <- list(
  booster           = "gbtree",
  objective         = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric       = "aucpr",
  eta               = 0.05,
  max_depth         = 6,
  gamma             = 10,
  min_child_weight  = 6,

  alpha             = 0
)
```

```{r}
train_xgb <- function(X, y, params, folds, max_nrounds = 500) {
  params$objective   <- "binary:logistic"
  params$eval_metric <- "aucpr"
  
  # remove keys that xgboost might misinterpret
  params <- params[!(names(params) %in% c("nrounds", "nthread"))]
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(X), label = y)
  
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    data = dtrain,
    params = params,
    nrounds = max_nrounds,
    folds = folds,
    nthread = 8,
    early_stopping_rounds = 10,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration
  message("Training with ", best_nrounds, " boosting rounds.")
  
  bst <- xgb.train(
    params  = params,
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_nrounds,
    nthread = 8,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  list(model = bst, best_nrounds = best_nrounds)
}

predict_and_score <- function(model_obj, X_test, y_test) {
  bst <- if (is.list(model_obj)) model_obj$model else model_obj
  
  p_hat <- predict(bst, as.matrix(X_test))
  
  logloss <- -mean(y_test * log(p_hat + 1e-15) + (1 - y_test) * log(1 - p_hat + 1e-15))
  
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_test == 1],
                        scores.class1 = p_hat[y_test == 0],
                        curve = FALSE)
  
  list(
    preds = data.table(prob = p_hat, label = y_test),
    metrics = list(logloss = logloss, auprc = pr$auc.integral)
  )
}

```

```{r}
folds <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$chr)

consensus_model <- train_xgb(
  X = data[, ..feature_cols],
  y = data$label,
  params = consensus_params,
  folds = folds,
  max_nrounds = 500
)

xgb.save(consensus_model$model,
         file.path(MODEL_DIR, "xgb_consensus_pgBoost.model"))
```
